question: What immediate effect does the practice have on an intellect afflicted by time?
premises: The practice acts upon the intellect.
It can affect even one bitten by time.
The effect occurs in an instant.
inference: The practice instantly makes happy even an intellect afflicted by time.
uncertainties: The subject performing sukhī+karoti is implied from the preceding context.
plain_english: It makes the intellect happy in an instant, even one bitten by time.
